plugin.name: Requirements
plugin.description: Rapport.esp: found. Rapport runs the scenes and keeps the bond between you and everyone you talk to. Overture needs 0.2.1 or newer and tells you in game if yours is older. XDI.esm: found. Extended Dialogue Interface shows the dialogue wheel. AAF.esm: found. Advanced Animation Framework plays the scene when someone says yes. F4SE: check this yourself. Rapport is an F4SE plugin, so start the game through f4se_loader.exe (Fallout 4 Script Extender, f4se.silverlock.org). MCM: check this yourself. Optional: Mod Configuration Menu gives Overture its settings page; without it Overture runs on its defaults.

plugin.name: Its own button
plugin.description: E is always their own talk: their quest, their shop, their story. R, "Overture", opens a short menu: Try your luck, Follow me, Just talk, Later. Someone who invited you back still opens on E.

plugin.name: Four ways to try
plugin.description: Offer, Charm, Blunt or Linger. Every NPC is one of four kinds of people, and each way lands with exactly one of them. The game never says who is which: you learn it from how they answer. The place matters too: in front of an audience the intimate ways recoil, and someone who would say yes answers "not here" until you find somewhere private.

plugin.name: Both sides are voiced
plugin.description: Every NPC line is spoken in 11 voices, and you speak too, in one of two voices designed for this mod. Characters with their own actor answer in the closest voice there is, through Rapport. Keep Sound\Voice\Overture.esp loose: packed into an archive, lines go silent or borrow the wrong voice.

plugin.name: Companions: Ask for a moment
plugin.description: Companions have a system of their own: days together, fights survived and their own affinity bring you closer, and a companion who wants you may find a moment to say so. You can ask them for a moment too. Works with the game's own companions and Amazing Follower Tweaks.

plugin.name: Follow me
plugin.description: Someone who says "not here" follows you somewhere quieter, and anyone you've warmed up can be asked from the Overture menu. They keep to their own place: anywhere in their town or settlement, about 60 m in the open. Once you're alone they speak first.
